title: audit.jsonl line
description: One audit entry with the person as actor or as resource of kind user or principal (docs/spec/20-privacy.md section 5.2). It holds no hashes, no details (no free-text reason, no IP pseudonym) and no device, session or correlation IDs.

seq.description: Position of the entry in the audit log, ascending within the file.

occurred_at.description: When the entry was recorded, RFC 3339 in UTC.

action.description: Action ID of docs/spec/05-actions.md, for example user.disable.

reason_code.description: Reason code of a refusal from the closed list of docs/spec/07-permissions.md section 4.1; absent when there is none.

resource_kind.description: Kind of the resource the action concerned, for example user, principal, message or grant; absent when the entry names none.

resource_id.description: ID of that resource; absent when the entry names none.

actor_kind.description: principal when a principal acted, system for the system or a server command.

actor_id.description: ID of the acting principal; present only when actor_kind is principal.
